hooks.command: FILE=$(cat | python3 -c "import sys,json; ti=json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}); print(ti.get('file_path',ti.get('path','')))" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$FILE" ] || ! echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.py$' || ! [ -f "$FILE" ] && exit 0; ruff check "$FILE" 2>&1 || { echo "ruff errors above" >&2; exit 2; }
